description: High-performance late-interaction retrieval engine for on-prem AI. ColBERT/ColPali multi-vector search with Rust fused MaxSim, Triton GPU kernels, ROQ quantization, LEMUR routing, WAL-backed CRUD, and a FastAPI server — single machine, CPU or GPU.
